propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous self-re-dispatch (RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS=false) to a single hourly cron schedule entry at minute 23 to avoid GitHub's contended :00 slot.

CloudWatch alarm bridge_run_failures must be retuned from threshold=1/evaluation_periods=1 to threshold=0/evaluation_periods=2/datapoints_to_alarm=2 to remain firable at hourly cadence, preventing silent monitoring regression.
Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron and assert exactly one schedule entry, uniform 60-minute gaps, and non-zero minute offset.
All documentation, comments, and test fixtures referencing 40-minute cadence must be updated to hourly; worst-case sync latency is now 1 hour.
Terraform drift remediation requires operator to execute terraform apply to deploy the alarm retuning before bridge failure alerting resumes.
